title: 电话订餐厅：本周听力迁移检查
subtitle: Booking a table and changing the number of guests
level: Listening A1 transfer check · Reading A2–B1

audio.title: Booking a table
audio.note: 本周迁移检查：使用此前未练过的同难度音频 0:00–1:25。已实际打开并播放来源页，核验完整音频时长为 2分06.96秒，且页面 Transcript 与原音匹配。前两遍严禁展开 Transcript；完整原文在来源页的 Transcript 标签中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕迁移检查｜抓人数、时间与修改内容（5分钟）
sections.body:
这是本周迁移检查。播放 0:00–1:25，前两遍不要看下方关键词、精听提示或 Transcript。

第一遍：不暂停，只判断这是现场点餐、电话订位，还是取消聚会。听完立即用一句中文或简单英语说主旨。
第二遍：仍不暂停，只记你听到的数字和发生变化的信息；漏掉一句也继续。
第三遍：完成两道题并记录第一次听懂比例。只有答完后才进入精听。第三方原文仅短提示一句：“Can I book a table?”
questions: Jamie 第一次订了几个人、几点的桌位？
Jamie 再次打电话，主要想把什么改成 six？
sections.answers:
1. A table for four at half past seven the next evening.
2. He wants to change the booking from four people to six people, not change the time to six o'clock.

sections.title: 2. 对答案后精听＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
现在才可以看提示。每处按“先定位原音 → 看短句 → 模仿两遍 → 关文字重听”练习。

① Can I book a table?｜Can I 自然连成 Can_I；a 很轻，重音在 book、table。
② What time would you like?｜would you 常连得接近 /wʊdʒə/；time、like 更清楚。
③ I was wondering if I can make it for six instead.｜was、if、I、for 较弱；make_it 连读，six、instead 承担信息重音。

最后关掉文字重听 0:00–1:25，跟读一句后立刻换数字再说一次，例如 four → six、half past seven → eight。
questions: would you 在自然语流中可能听起来接近什么？
make it for six 中，six 为什么要重读？
sections.answers:
1. 接近 /wʊdʒə/。
2. 因为 six 是要修改的新人数，是关键信息。

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜朋友聚餐前修改预订（4分钟）
sections.body: Nora planned a birthday dinner for her friend Mia. On Monday, she called a small Italian restaurant and booked a table for four at seven thirty on Saturday. The restaurant was busy, but the staff member found a table near the window. The next day, two more friends said they could come. Nora called again and politely asked to change the booking from four people to six. At first, the staff member thought she wanted a table at six o'clock. Nora calmly explained that six was the number of guests, not the time. A larger table was available near the kitchen. Nora accepted it and also moved the booking to eight o'clock because one friend finished work late. Before ending the call, she repeated the name, date, number of people and time. This final check prevented another misunderstanding and made the dinner easier for everyone.
questions: What misunderstanding happened during Nora's second call?
What details did Nora confirm before ending the call?
sections.translation: 诺拉为朋友米娅安排生日晚餐。周一，她打电话给一家小型意大利餐厅，预订了周六晚上七点半的四人桌。餐厅很忙，但工作人员找到了一个靠窗的位置。第二天，又有两位朋友说能来。诺拉再次打电话，礼貌地请求把预订人数从四人改为六人。起初，工作人员以为她想把时间改到六点。诺拉平静地解释，six 指的是客人人数，而不是时间。厨房附近有一张更大的桌子。诺拉接受了，并把时间改到八点，因为有位朋友下班较晚。挂电话前，她重复确认了姓名、日期、人数和时间。最后的确认避免了另一次误会，也让大家的晚餐安排更顺利。
sections.answers:
1. The staff member thought six meant six o'clock, but Nora meant six people.
2. She confirmed the booking name, date, number of guests and time.

sections.title: 4. 词汇与高频词块｜预订与修改信息（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. book a table｜预订桌位｜I'd like to book a table for Saturday. 我想预订周六的桌位。
2. a table for ...｜……人的桌位｜Can I get a table for four? 可以订四人桌吗？
3. What time would you like?｜您想几点？｜What time would you like on Friday? 您周五想几点？
4. half past seven｜七点半｜Our booking is at half past seven. 我们订的是七点半。
5. under the name ...｜以……姓名预订｜It's under the name Nora. 预订姓名是诺拉。
6. make it for six｜改成六人/六点，依语境判断｜Could you make it for six people? 能改成六个人吗？
7. change the time｜修改时间｜I'd like to change the time to eight. 我想把时间改到八点。
8. Is eight OK for you?｜八点可以吗？｜Is eight OK for your group? 你们一行人八点可以吗？
9. no problem｜没问题｜A table near the kitchen is no problem. 靠近厨房的桌位没问题。
sections.answers: 优先记住 8 个词块：book a table / a table for ... / What time would you like? / half past seven / under the name ... / make it for six / change the time / Is eight OK for you?

sections.title: 5. 语法｜Can I ...? 与 Could I ...? 的礼貌请求（3分钟）
sections.body:
Can I ...? 是自然常用的请求；Could I ...? 语气更委婉。两者后面都接动词原形，不接 to，也不用动词-ing。

例句 1：Can I book a table for four? 我可以订一张四人桌吗？
例句 2：Could I change the booking to eight o'clock? 我可以把预订改到八点吗？
questions: 填空：Could I ___ (change) the number of guests?
改错：Can I to book a table for six?
sections.answers:
1. change
2. Can I book a table for six?

sections.title: 6. 原创电话对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创双人对话
A: Hello, Bella's Restaurant. How can I help?
B: Hi. Could I book a table for four on Saturday?
A: Of course. What time would you like?
B: Is half past seven available?
A: Yes. What name is it under?
B: Nora. Could I call later if the number changes?
A: No problem. Your table is booked for four at seven thirty.

替换练习
① four → two / six；Saturday → Friday evening / Sunday lunch。
② half past seven → eight o'clock；Nora → your own name。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 餐厅问几个人。→ A table for four, please.
2) 七点半没有位置，对方提供九点。→ Nine is fine, thank you.
3) 你要把四人改成六人。→ Could I make it for six people instead?

30–60 秒口头任务：完成一次电话订位，说出日期、时间、人数和姓名；随后增加两位客人并礼貌修改预订，最后复述确认。
sections.answers: 示例：Hello, could I book a table for four on Saturday at half past seven? The name is Nora. Actually, two more friends can come. Could I make it for six people instead? Eight o'clock is fine. So that's Saturday at eight, for six people, under Nora. Thank you.

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋迁移记录（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个词块，再接到今天的订位：
1. Are you free on ...?｜你……有空吗？
2. That works for me.｜这个安排适合我。
3. Where shall we meet?｜我们在哪里见？

快速串联：Are you free on Saturday? Seven thirty works for me. Where shall we meet? I'll book a table.

请回原聊天告诉我：① 本次未预习听力第一遍听懂比例；② four / six 或 seven thirty 哪处最容易混；③ 用英文文字或语音完成 30–60 秒订位任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 迁移检查完成标准：前两遍不看提示，能抓住场景，并正确说出首次预订的四人、七点半和再次来电要改为六人。
